Yeah that works, you could probably also try and fuel a rebellion in the two western islands, which both have prominent Argossian populations.

The thing with that is the Aboriginal Argossians and shamatine Astanirans kinda hate each other. Basically, the shamatine people originally settled on the main island very early due to its proximity to shamat, but the aboriginal Argossians arrived later (the reason for their voyage away from Argos is unclear, but speculated that there was some kinda of war/genocide that went unknown because it took place in the middle of unclaimed Argos deserts) and made their settlements in unoccupied parts of the island. Both of them claimed the island and there were frequent wars and stuff. Then Hydronians arrived and colonised the place, capitalising on the existing chaos, but they only settled the southern parts, creating a border between the shamatine people who now identified as Astaniran and the aboriginals in the north. After Hydronia left their was a bunch of instability in Astanir (mutiple coups and a civil war) but eventually the junta government took control and expanded north and to the surrounding islands, suppressing the aboriginals and blaming them for their problems.

The democratic forces would likely be more open to collaboration than the argossians, especially considering the argossians havent even banded together yet, but yknow, nothings impossible ig

[b][u]Supporting our fellow Argossians.[/u][/b]

As Astanir erupted into blody civil war the Nordiheimian took notice and interest, especialy in the uprising of the long oppresed Argossian tribes.
It was decided be the council of Nordiheim that they would support their distant cousins in an attempt for them to attaining a bether future for them selfs by suplying them with arms and suplies.

But it was however noticed that the different tribes and enclaves of the Argossian Millitias could not exactly be called a coherent military force, but more a bunch of groups that was shoting at the same enemies to achive similar goals, this would [b]never[/b] allow them a victory of any cind, be it independance or a bether life after the civil war reached its conclusion.
As such the Nordiheimian military and diplomatic departments sendt groups and task forces to contact the different groups/tribes with a couple of goals to achive:
1) To conect them in talks and cooperation to creat a unified and bether organized military to fight ageinst their common enemy and goal.
2) To help train their military forces in ragular and irregular military tactics and logistics.
3) Organice a unified military and logistics command.

They would also be supplied with basic infantry weapons and equipment pluss support weapons like MMS-60 LW mortars, light 105mm L/30 LT Artillery pieces, SA-7 AXS manpads and FAF-1 Pillum anti-tank weapons.
When it came to vehicles they would start small to not overload their logistics as it was at the moment not unified, giving them more basic trucks, rough terrain vehicles (basicly civilian models) and several types and versions of the Kangaroo MAMIV (but not any with the AAAMS-2B Valkyrie) for transport of troops, material/logistics and as gun platforms together with the needed fuel, parts and munitions.
When their logistics and cooperation/unity started to improve and work as one then it would become possible to arm them with heavier equipment and vehicles.

Several groups of agents, some from the ancient Shadow Keepers group, would also start to check for oppurtunities of geting the Aboriginals on the two western islands to rise up in rebellion aswell as finding out if there was any of the other factions that could become allies (or atleast not enemies) with the Argosian Millitias, the most potentialy promising of the other factions would be the [i]'Democratic Army of Astanir'[/i] as they sought to change Astanir into a Democracy, someting the Nordiheimians could get behind, but they had to be carefull and [u]very[/u] diplomatic about this as there was no lack of bad blood between the Argossians and the Shamatans.
Perhaps showing them that Argossians and Shamatans could work and live together could be done by pointing out Nordiheims own unity and cooperation between these two continental people groups?
